lead_raw_text:
The structure of YbAgS₂ crystallizes in the tetragonal space group P4/nmm (No. 38), with a unit cell containing eight atoms—two Yb, two Ag, and four S—distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis gives Ag a tetrahedral environment of four S neighbors (2.69–2.82 Å) and Yb an eight-vertex coordination polyhedron of eight S neighbors (3.08–3.10 Å). The Ag tetrahedra share corners with one another and edges with Yb polyhedra, while Yb polyhedra share corners and edges; the geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional.
